i42: Marc Rockmore joined the Department this fall. Marc received his BA from Swarthmore College and his PhD from Cornell University. His research examines the impact of conflict on the development process. While his dissertation examined people’s responses to the insecurity caused by conflict, his upcoming research looks at the lasting effects of exposure to violence on post- conflict economic outcomes. Marc will be teaching courses in development economics.
